title: More than a place to walk your dog, Syracuse park receives international recognition
summary: The James Pass Arboretum in Tipperary Hill has received international recognition under Chief Arborist Stephen Harris's leadership since 2010, transforming the nearly 100-year-old park from underutilized space into a destination asset. This reflects the city's investment in parks infrastructure and neighborhood revitalization with potential economic-development spillover effects.
